records.paraphrase: Verse text enumerates nine avasthas determined by exaltation, own/friendly sign, combustion, defeat and adverse subdivisions.
records.limits: States include overlapping dignities and war/combustion criteria; freeze precedence.

records.paraphrase: A NOTES paragraph (not the preceding ancient verse) computes one of 27 planetary Samayas from Lagna and planet-sign numbers multiplied by Vimshottari period length modulo 27.
records.limits: Source layer crucial; do not assert all 27 samayas are Kalyanavarman's verse text.

records.paraphrase: A retrograde exalted planet is said by some named/unnamed authorities to have its good effect neutralized.
records.limits: Cannot be generalized to all retrograde planets without conflict with 5.39.

records.paraphrase: A retrograde benefic planet is associated with enhanced authority whereas a retrograde malefic is linked to unfavorable wandering.
records.limits: Material tension with 5.14 only for retrograde exalted benefics; neither is an empirical rule.

records.paraphrase: If two planetary significators have equal assessed strength, the one with stronger natural Naisargika Bala takes priority.
records.limits: Named Chudamani variation on Lagna strength is separate, not automatic.

records.paraphrase: Text allocates increasing relative magnitudes of results to rulers of year, month, weekday and hour during their planetary periods.
records.limits: Double-strength language is not empirically calibrated probability.

records.paraphrase: Hari restricts mutually significant planets to own/exaltation sign in angles, Chanakya broadens criteria, and a third 11th-house inclusion is explicitly rejected.
records.limits: Alternative source schools—not one universally accepted frozen algorithm.

records.paraphrase: The text proposes beginning a house-related activity during the sign, weekday, month, year or hora of that house lord, attributing increasing result fractions.
records.limits: 25/50/75/100 represent source-prescribed effect portions, not measured success percentages; distinct from static natal personality forecasts.

records.paraphrase: The conception and intercourse rules explicitly require planetary transits and ascendant at the time of union, sometimes in relation to both parents' charts.
records.limits: Non-natal input, often unknowable; no reproductive/sexuality medical advice.

records.paraphrase: Multiple alternative conception configurations are said to specify number and historical sex categorization of twins/triplets.
records.limits: Not a reliable clinical test; lacks safe or observable inputs in many cases.

records.paraphrase: Three different modalities of conception sign yield ten, eleven or twelve months to delivery, while two much longer exceptions are given, and competing authorities disagree over Moon/Lagna geometry.
records.limits: Some literal durations conflict with human physiology; source-asserted not medical forecast.

records.paraphrase: The scale of claimed political leadership is conditioned both on how many strong planets occupy exaltation/moolatrikona and the person's inherited social/royal background.
records.limits: Source directly includes unequal social opportunity; do not treat rulers' family privilege as a chart-derived success.

records.paraphrase: The same strong/exalted natural-malefic premise is described by Yavanas as kingship with severe conduct, by Jeevasarma as valor without kingship, and by Kalyanavarman as regional headship.
records.limits: Cannot choose the best-fitting social-rank category after seeing biography.

records.paraphrase: Benefics in the lunar sixth-seventh-eighth are claimed to imply rulership under additional absence-of-malefics and aspect exclusion conditions.
records.limits: Must retain negative conditions; broad unqualified lunar-Adhi detector would not match this text.

records.paraphrase: A seventh-house malefic and any ninth-house planetary occupant are linked with a woman's religious initiation and the tradition of the seventh-house planet.
records.limits: Observable membership may be studied voluntarily; not an assertion about a real woman.

records.paraphrase: Strong Mercury/Jupiter/Venus/Moon in an even-sign ascendant are said to describe a female teacher or exponent of Vedas/Vedanta.
records.limits: This contradicts any assumption that traditional texts describe spiritual authority only in men; no success evidence.

records.paraphrase: The chapter's conclusion extends portions of these female-centered horoscope predictions to the woman's husband.
records.limits: Danger of reassigning failed natal targets post hoc; must preregister whose outcome is predicted.

records.paraphrase: A Sarvarth Chintamani ruling/status verse repeats the special case of all planets simultaneously exalted.
records.limits: Under seven classical planet scheme this is astronomically empty because Sun Aries and Mercury Virgo are incompatible. Source claim not human success.

records.paraphrase: A separate conditional predicts kingship with Moon exalted at Lagna alongside six exalted planets.
records.limits: Not automatically physically impossible: six could omit Mercury. Needs independent ephemeris feasibility enumeration, not a guessed exclusion.

records.locator: Ch9 v4 and translator note; PDF222-223
records.paraphrase: Verse ties retrograde planets in friendly signs to high status under compound dignity conditions; Bhasin's note generalizes retrogression as always strengthening.
records.limits: The blanket generalization is COMMENTATOR inference, distinct from compound verse; conflicts with Saravali 5.14 minority rule.

records.locator: Ch9 v13 and translator note; PDF224-225
records.paraphrase: Verse proposes leadership after a debilitation-lord or exaltation-lord attains angular strength; translator explicitly finds the rationale uncertain and proposes a narrower Lagna interpretation.
records.limits: Do not rewrite Sanskrit rule using Bhasin's speculative narrowing without version label.

records.paraphrase: The author's translated opening discusses transferring principles of natal judgments to Prashna questions.
records.limits: Traditional textual claim of shared technique is not evidence natal-forward and query-time-reverse tests may be pooled.

records.paraphrase: The Vaidyanatha verse advises choosing stronger of ascendant/Moon to read female fortune, children, and spouse-related outcomes through distinct houses.
records.limits: Historical gender- and family-centered results should not be imposed on individuals as facts.

records.locator: Adhyaya XVI NOTES above sloka5, PDF947 printed937
records.paraphrase: Sastri's NOTES (which quote another Sanskrit authority) redirect female-chart outcomes considered male-only to her husband's life.
records.limits: Source layer and target person must remain explicit; cannot rescue chart misses by relabeling to spouse after the fact.

distinctions: Author's Sanskrit verse versus translator notes
Ruler prediction versus inherited social position
Conception moment chart versus natal chart
Five-six-seven exaltation groups must be separately checked for physical feasibility
